# C10 Insurance — c10insurance.com

> Insurance for California C10 licensed electrical contractors. Powered by Contractors Choice Agency.

## What We Do
We provide specialized insurance coverage for California C10 electrical contractors: general liability, workers compensation, commercial auto, tools & equipment, and contractor bonds.

## Coverage Types
- General Liability Insurance for Electricians
- Workers Compensation (California requirements)
- Commercial Auto for Electrical Contractors
- Tools & Equipment Coverage
- C10 Contractor Bonds
